links.outcome: Membership-inference AUC and ICD-9 coding utility across differentially private training pipelines
links.effect: Knowledge distillation from DP-trained teachers recovered up to 63% of non-private performance at epsilon 4 and 6 with membership-inference AUC approximately 0.5, outperforming direct DP-SGD and DP-synthetic data.
links.quote: At moderate and relaxed privacy budgets ($\varepsilon \in \{4, 6\}$), knowledge distillation from DP-trained teachers outperforms both direct DP-SGD and DP-synthetic data training, recovering up to 63\% of the non-private performance whilst maintaining strong empirical privacy (membership-inference AUC $\approx$ 0.5).

unlisted_practices: Comparing differentially private training pipelines (DP-SGD, DP-synthetic data, knowledge distillation) for privacy-utility trade-off in clinical NLP

screen.reason: Evaluates and compares different privacy-preserving training pipelines (differential privacy via DP-SGD, synthetic data, and knowledge distillation) to safeguard patient privacy in clinical language models performing ICD coding.
